points.description: Defines DHCP: a network management protocol used on IP networks in which a DHCP server dynamically assigns an IP address and other network configuration parameters to each host/device on the network (equivalent wording accepted).

States what it is used for: simplifies/automates configuration and administration of end systems (automatic IP address assignment, supports dynamic allocation/reuse of addresses) and may provide additional information such as DNS server, netmask, default router.

rubric.notes: Full marks: correct definition (protocol where a server dynamically assigns IP address and configuration parameters) plus a correct use (automatic configuration/IP assignment, extra info like DNS, netmask, router). Half marks for only one of the two parts. Equivalent wording is accepted.
